answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism measures each identity's unique response-time signature against a shared willow-tree oracle that imposes a sable 3-second cooldown after every query. Farms must either serialize their heads (incurring gale-scale cumulative delays that destroy any profit margin) or purchase independent proxy routes whose price scales with concurrent demand. The oracle returns a signed timestamp; the network rejects answers whose latency clusters within 200ms of peers from the same subnet. Honest agents pay only ordinary network jitter.
